description: List the strategies published on brighter.fi, newest or best-performing first. Each carries its rebalance cadence, the assets it can hold, and its return over the chosen period against its benchmark. Strategies that can hold leveraged or inverse funds are excluded unless asked for.

assets.description: Only strategies that can hold any of these tickers.

beatsBenchmark.description: Only strategies ahead of their benchmark over the period.

leveraged.description: Include strategies that can hold leveraged or inverse funds. Off by default.

name: list_strategies
